speaker: Doctor
text: I have noted your history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, falls, forgetfulness, and paranoia. To determine if this is a neurological or psychiatric emergency, have you noticed any recent changes in your vision, such as double vision or loss of vision in one eye?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hashimoto's Encephalopathy (Steroid-responsive Encephalopathy associated with Autoimmune Thyroiditis).

I need to confirm if you have a history of thyroid disease or if your physician has ever checked your thyroid antibodies for you. Please also tell me if you have experienced any seizures or severe headaches recently. REQUEST TEST: Anti-thyroid Antibodies (Anti-TPO, Anti-Tg).
